## Change

Describe the concrete problem and the behavior after this change.

## Verification

List checks you actually ran and their results. Separate automated tests from full IDE checks, and identify anything not verified.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused scope and appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] User-visible changes are documented in English and in the changelog.
- [ ] No private paths, credentials, proprietary fixtures, local settings, or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Compatibility and analysis limitations remain accurate.
